manifest.name: Free Game Check

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Free Game Check - Refresh
THSV Addon - Free Game Check - Discord Deliver

installationSteps: Import the Free Game Check Streamer.bot package and leave both actions triggerless.
Approve Refresh and, only when Discord is enabled, Discord Deliver. Keep the private webhook only in its Set Argument.
Create Twitch and Kick Free Games rewards and paste their stable IDs. Keep one Reward Redemption trigger on each existing platform intake.
Create the configured no-response command for YouTube and TikTok through Command Sync.
Add the Discord invite and guide wording, then enable the add-on.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling preserves only bounded giveaway IDs, cooldowns, and refresh/delivery status.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded public giveaway discovery and source-routed viewer guidance are available.
